elaine: Heads-up — Helix (enterprise payments) wants a 7-day POC to replace VendorZ. Primary asks: drop-in API, identical JSON contract, and a reconciliation of token billing. They want a smoke on Friday. Can we scope?

raj: I can lead the runbook and acceptance tests. Need their sample client snippet + 50 anonymized requests, plus the security questionnaire. Who owns the compatibility shim?

tess: I9ll build the shim. Plan: proxy that rewrites request/response shapes and a prompt-normalizer. 48h for MVP, 24h for error-code parity. Need examples of their error cases.

omar: Infra note: we can provide fixed egress IPs or a VPC peer. For quick POC reserving egress 3.121.55.10, 3.121.55.11. Also confirm streaming semantics — do they expect chunked frames or token deltas?

elaine: They use chunked streaming and a specific boundary header. Tess, can you emulate chunked streaming?

tess: Yes — will add an adapter that buffers and emits vendor-style chunks. Will include a small local test harness for them.

omar: infra-bot: created sandbox helix-poc-2026 in us-east-1, creds DMed to elaine, egress ips 3.121.55.10/11 assigned :white_check_mark:

raj: Acceptance criteria draft:
- 25 canonical requests run through parity harness with semantic score >=0.9
- Response JSON keys identical for their parser in all smoke cases
- p95 latency <= 480ms in staging
- Billing reconciliation CSV mapping VendorZ tokens -> Redwood tokens delivered
- No open critical items in security questionnaire

elaine: Security blocker: Helix wants BYOK with HSM for production. They9re okay with Dedicated + attestation for POC, but will require Private for full BYOK. Flag as potential procurement blocker.

omar: Noted. Also tokenizer delta: VendorZ token count ~+9% vs ours. Tess will add token-reporting metadata so they can reconcile charges.

tess: Example curl shim for Helix to run locally: 
```
curl -X POST https://poc.helix-shim.redwood.ai/v1/complete \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \n  -d '{"input":"<sample>","max_tokens":128}'
```
We return VendorZ-shaped JSON: {"request_id":"...","chunks":[{"text":"...","seq":0}],"meta":{}}

raj: Also include deterministic sampling option for the POC to reduce non-deterministic diffs. Ask Helix for their SLA targets and incident notification window.

elaine: I'll send invite for Wed kickoff and attach questionnaire + sample prompts. If BYOK forces Private, escalate to solutions eng + legal. Anything else?

omar: Add fallback: if capacity constrained route to quantized variant and document expected output diffs in runbook.

tess: Will add tokenizer mapping, prompt normalizer, and a small eval harness. Dropping initial PR today.

elaine: Great — thanks everyone. Posting follow-ups after kickoff.
